competency.title: Reproduce metaplasticity — human review
competency.outcome: Reproduce a stated result for metaplasticity using a two-timescale plasticity simulation. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.measure: adaptation of the learning threshold after prior activity

competency.practice_task: Produce a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands grounded in a two-timescale plasticity simulation.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report adaptation of the learning threshold after prior activity with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: treating the threshold as fixed.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of metaplasticity.
Practice: the rerun agrees within a predeclared tolerance.
Measurement: report adaptation of the learning threshold after prior activity against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for treating the threshold as fixed; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
